name: glua-lsp
description: Language server for Garry's Mod Lua — AST-based IntelliSense, realm awareness, hook and net message analysis, cross-file diagnostics.

commands.title: GLua: Treat This File As GLua
GLua: Treat This File As Plain Lua

markdownEnumDescriptions: Take over `.lua` files only in workspaces that look like Garry's Mod addons or gamemodes.
Take over every `.lua` file. Use this if detection misses your layout.
Never take over `.lua` files. Only `.glua` files are handled.
glua.activation.markdownDescription: Controls when `.lua` files are treated as GLua instead of plain Lua. `auto` keeps this extension out of the way of Love2D, Luau, Neovim and other Lua projects.

glua.workspace.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of Lua files to index in a workspace.

glua.workspace.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from workspace indexing.

glua.diagnostics.undefinedGlobal.description: Reading a global that is neither a known GMod API member nor assigned anywhere in the workspace.

glua.diagnostics.realmViolation.markdownDescription: Calling a serverside-only function from a clientside file, or vice versa. The function is nil in that realm, so the call fails at runtime.

glua.diagnostics.unusedLocal.description: Locals that are declared but never read.

glua.diagnostics.deprecated.description: Use of API members the wiki marks as deprecated.

glua.diagnostics.argumentCount.description: Calling a known API function with too few or too many arguments.

glua.diagnostics.argumentType.description: Passing an argument whose inferred type cannot match the documented parameter type.

glua.diagnostics.unknownHook.markdownDescription: `hook.Add` with a name that is neither a documented hook nor called by `hook.Run`/`hook.Call` anywhere in the workspace. Catches typos like `"PlayerSpawned"`.

glua.diagnostics.netMessage.markdownDescription: `net.Start` on a message never passed to `util.AddNetworkString`, and `net.Receive` for a message never sent.

glua.diagnostics.netReadWriteMismatch.markdownDescription: The sequence of `net.Write*` calls in a `net.Start` block does not match the `net.Read*` calls in the matching `net.Receive`.

glua.diagnostics.missingAddCSLuaFile.markdownDescription: A clientside file that is never passed to `AddCSLuaFile`, so it will never reach clients.

glua.diagnostics.globalWrite.description: Writing to a global instead of declaring a local. Noisy by design; off unless you want it.

glua.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter names inline at call sites of known API functions.

glua.inlayHints.realm.description: Show the inferred realm at the top of each file.

glua.completion.callSnippets.description: Insert parentheses and tab stops for parameters when completing a function.

glua.completion.filterByRealm.description: Hide API members that cannot exist in the current file's realm.

glua.hover.wikiLinks.description: Include a link to the Garry's Mod wiki in hover documentation.

glua.trace.server.description: Trace communication with the language server.
